HEIGHT ADJUSTABLE MIC STAND - 24 to 67 inches, using the clutch to suit different performers and applications.

The portable mic stand design allows for easy disassembly and storage. This versatile stand includes 2 adjustable mic clips for precise positioning and a metal screw adapter compatible with most mikes. Benefit from hassle-free height adjustments, efficient wire management, and a robust build that is perfect for any setting.

Quick release mechanisms for adjusting height can save time and effort, especially in live on stage performance settings.



Cable management clips help keep wires organized and out of the way, reducing the risk of tripping or accidental disconnection.
